announcements.headline: Press speculation and Suspension of Listing
announcements.insight: Miotal Plc shares are suspended due to press speculation. This follows a strategic change in July and an opportunity update in November.

announcements.headline: Update on Opportunity
announcements.insight: Following the July strategy change, this update signals progress in executing the new direction. Shareholders should watch for further details on how the revised plan is being implemented.

announcements.headline: Change in Strategy
announcements.insight: Following the June interim results, a strategy change suggests a significant pivot. Shareholders should monitor for details on how this alters the previously reported financial trajectory.

announcements.headline: Interim Results to 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: Interim Results to 31 March 2026 are published. Shareholders should watch for financial performance details in the full report.
